title: Mayong Mistmoore
group: The Hour of the Last Eclipse
summary: Answer the crimson covenants, control the shades and survive the final eclipse.
overview: Mayong Mistmoore combines retreat, spread and gathering mechanics with repeated shade summons. Two health gates demand coordinated use of the four guardian seals before the final phase accelerates the fight.
Keep the raid in the courtyard battle area. Assign seal users and a caller before engaging; dealing more damage cannot bypass an unanswered covenant.

roles.label: Tanks
tips: Keep Mayong near his courtyard home with space for both retreat and gathering mechanics.
Expect his melee hits to increase by 35% while a crimson covenant is active.
Control shades promptly and keep the boss accessible to seal users.

roles.label: Healers
tips: Plan healing around the six-second movement warnings and increased tank damage during covenants.
The crimson brand's bearer can still take the blast after separating from the raid.
Remain inside the battle boundary; outside healing and resurrection support are rejected.

roles.label: Damage dealers
tips: Prioritize shades before their one-minute renewal and coordinate boss damage with movement.
Save major damage opportunities for after a covenant breaks, when Mayong no longer reduces incoming damage to one tenth.
At 20%, respond to faster warnings and continue controlling adds while finishing the encounter.

roles.label: Seal bearers
tips: Target Mayong, move within 100 paces and maintain line of sight before invoking a seal.
At 75%, use Grave, Keep, Hunt and Choir once each in any order.
At 45%, follow Keep, Choir, Grave, Hunt. Each successful invocation advances the litany.
Allow the three-second item cast to complete. The seals share a 60-second reuse timer, so assign users before the pull.

phases.label: The master of Mistmoore
phases.description: Every 22 seconds, Mayong cycles through a retreat warning, a crimson brand and a gathering warning. Each movement warning allows six seconds to react. He also attempts to summon two shades every 35 seconds.

phases.label: The first covenant
phases.description: Mayong takes only one tenth of incoming damage and increases his melee damage by 35%. Invoke Grave, Keep, Hunt and Choir once each in any order to break the covenant. He attempts to summon up to two shades when the covenant begins, without exceeding six living shades.

phases.label: The final litany
phases.description: The covenant returns and Mayong attempts to summon up to two more shades, without exceeding six living shades. Break this covenant by invoking the seals in order: Keep, Choir, Grave, Hunt. Incorrect or repeated seals do not advance the litany.

phases.label: The final eclipse
phases.description: Movement warnings accelerate to every 12 seconds and regular shade summons to every 24 seconds. Pulse damage also increases. The six-second response window remains.

abilities.name: Ring of Blood
abilities.summary: Retreat more than 35 paces from Mayong.
description: After a six-second warning, a pulse strikes raiders and pets within 35 paces of Mayong's position and in line of sight of its center.
Move out for the pulse, then return to the planned position while remaining inside the battle.

abilities.name: Crimson Brand
abilities.summary: Separate the marked raider from the group by more than 25 paces.
description: A random eligible raider receives the brand and a private warning. Six seconds later, the blast resolves around that player's current position.
The blast can strike the marked player and nearby raiders or pets. The bearer should move away from allies, with healing ready for the impact.

abilities.name: Sheltering Shadows
description: When the shadows deepen, raiders have six seconds to move into the sheltered area around Mayong.
The pulse strikes beyond 20 paces out to 180 paces, subject to line of sight. Pets also need to be inside the sheltered area.

abilities.name: Crimson Covenant
abilities.summary: Complete the seal requirement to remove the ward and increased melee damage.
description: The covenant begins at 75% and 45% health. Incoming damage is reduced to one tenth and Mayong's melee damage increases by 35%.
Damage cannot force Mayong through the next phase while the covenant remains. The first covenant accepts all four seals in any order; the second requires Keep, Choir, Grave, Hunt.
The ward has no timeout. Complete the four successful invocations to remove it.

Entering a covenant cancels any movement pulse already counting down. The normal movement-warning rotation and regular shade summons continue during the covenant, so keep responding to new warnings while the seals are invoked.

abilities.name: Forgotten Shades
abilities.summary: Defeat shades before their one-minute renewal.
description: Mayong attempts to summon up to two shades every 35 seconds and when each covenant begins. These summons never exceed six living shades: one can appear if five are alive, and none if six are alive.
At 20% health, regular shade summons accelerate to every 24 seconds.
A warning announces the oldest shades at 45 seconds of age. At one minute, surviving shades dissolve and return at full strength.

sections.title: Guardian seals
paragraphs: Assign one or more raiders to each seal type before the pull. Two copies drop from each guardian, and the four seal types share one lore group, distributing them among different raiders.
Use the seal while targeting Mayong during an active covenant. The bearer must be a living expedition member, within 100 paces, on the battle's floor and in line of sight.
Each seal has a three-second cast and the seals share a 60-second reuse timer. An invocation counts after a successful cast; the same seal type can answer only once per covenant.
bullets: First covenant: Grave, Keep, Hunt and Choir, in any order.
Final litany: Keep, Choir, Grave, Hunt.

sections.title: Stay in the battle
paragraphs: Fight near the boss's home. Raiders and their pets must remain within 180 paces of the boss and within 30 paces vertically; attacks and aid from outside that boundary are rejected.
If no eligible living raider remains in the arena, or the boss is pulled too far from home, a warning precedes an encounter reset. Keep healers and resurrection targets inside the battle.

sections.title: Read the warnings
paragraphs: Mechanic warnings appear in the Event Messages chat filter. Movement mechanics give six seconds to respond.
Ground markers can supplement the warning when supported and enabled. Follow the chat instruction even if a marker is absent.
